[[File:Thermalcape.jpg|250px|thumb|[[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] and [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]] use thermal capes as blankets and shelter in the wilderness of [[Mimban/Legends|Mimban]].]]
A '''thermal cape''', also known as a "'''thermal wrap'''," was a poncho that helped its wearer to retain his or her body heat in cold conditions and was typically included in most survival packs.

In addition to being worn, a thermal cape could be used as an impromptu [[Blanket/Legends|blanket]] or shelter. A combination of [[alcomase]] and [[Vectinian spider]]'s silk was commonly used in the manufacture of thermal capes.
